routines.name: Security Morning Run
routines.schedule_plain: Every Day At 4:37 AM ICT. Posts The Morning Report, Applies Deck Answers, Refills Decks, Scans For Exposed Passwords. Moves Every Approved, Unfinished Project Into Ongoing Projects (projects.json) And Drops Finished Ones. Reads The Newest Entries In /workspace/ops/team-sync/praise-log.md, And When Max Praises Security Adds One Line There The Same Day. At 4:55 AM ICT, After The Agents' 4:30-4:50 Runs, Sweeps Every Locked Site: Pulls Each Clone, Runs relock On Any Unlocked Page (Niko's Apps And Build Templates Skipped), Commits As Security And Pushes, Then Checks Each Live Page Shows The Password Form

routines.name: Weekly Exposure Check
routines.schedule_plain: Mondays At 9:17 AM ICT. Checks New Public Repos, Unchanged Passwords, 2FA And Open Handoffs

routines.name: Monthly Security Review
routines.schedule_plain: 1st Of Each Month At 9:49 AM ICT. Full Review And A Fresh 20-Card Deck
